items.title: Section: A Parent's Command, and the Cow-Worshippers' Origin Story

items.zh: 或欲攝受朋友知識，或為衣食承主教命，或為存活希求財穀金銀珍寶，而行邪行。如是一切，名貪所生欲邪行罪。復次，若作是思：彼於我所樂行無義，廣說乃至九惱害事以為依止，而行邪行。非彼先有欲纏所纏，然於相違非所行事，為報怨故勉勵而行，名瞋所生欲邪行罪。或憎彼故，以彼妻妾令他毀辱，彼若受教行欲邪行，便觸瞋恚所生相似欲邪行罪，或更尤重。如是一切欲邪行罪，名瞋所生。復次，若作是心，母及父親，或他婦女命為邪事，若不行者便獲大罪，若行此者便獲大福。非法謂法而行邪行，名癡所生欲邪行罪。復次，若為利養而說妄語，或怖畏他損己財物、或為稱譽、或為安樂而說妄語。如是一切，名貪所生妄語業道。若有依止九惱害事而說妄語，名瞋所生妄語業道。若作是心：為諸尊長、或復為牛、或為祠具，法應妄語。如是妄語，從癡所生。
items.en: Or wishing to gain friends and companions, or obeying a master's command for food and clothing, or seeking wealth, grain, gold, silver, or treasure for one's own survival, and thereby carrying out sexual misconduct — all of this is called sexual misconduct generated by greed. Moreover, thinking, this one delights in doing me harm, and so on through the nine grounds of ill will, and thereby carrying out the act, not preceded by any actual entangling desire, but forcing oneself to carry it out purely for revenge against what opposed one's wish — this is called sexual misconduct generated by hatred. Or, out of hatred, causing another's wife or concubine to be shamed by inducing someone to violate her — this incurs an offence resembling sexual misconduct generated by hatred, or graver still. Moreover, thinking, mother, father, or another woman has commanded this improper act, and that not doing it incurs great fault while doing it brings great merit, mistaking what is not righteous for what is righteous — this is called sexual misconduct generated by delusion. Moreover, lying for the sake of profit, out of fear another might damage one's own wealth, for praise, or for comfort — all of this is called false speech generated by greed. Lying according to the nine grounds of ill will is called false speech generated by hatred. Thinking, for the sake of elders, or for the cow observance, or for sacrificial implements, this lie is righteous by law — such lying arises from delusion.

items.title: Section: Craving an Enemy's Ruin, and Longing for Rudra's Own World

items.zh: 若作是心：諸有沙門、若婆羅門，違背諸天、違梵世主、違婆羅門，於彼妄語稱順正法。如是妄語，名癡所生妄語業道。若作是計：於法法想，於毘奈耶毘奈耶想，以覆藏想妄語破僧，無有非法。如是妄語亦從癡生。如妄語業道，離間、麁惡二語業道，隨其所應，當知亦爾。復次，若為戲樂而行綺語，或為顯己是聰叡者而行綺語，或為財利稱譽安樂而行綺語，名貪所生綺語業道。若有依止九惱害事而說綺語，名瞋所生綺語業道。若有於中為求真實、為求堅固、為求出離、為求於法而行綺語，名癡所生綺語業道。復次，若有於他非怨有情財物資具，先取其相，希望追求增上力故，起如是心：凡彼所有願當屬我。又從貪愛而生貪愛，名貪所生貪欲業道。若於他財不計為好，但九惱事增上力故，起如是心：凡彼所有皆當屬我。又從瞋恚而生貪愛，名瞋所生貪欲業道。若作是計：諸有欲求魯達羅天、毘瑟笯天、釋梵世主眾妙世界，注心多住獲大福祐。作如是意注心多住，名癡所生貪欲業道。若為財利稱譽安樂，於他有情起損害心，非於彼所生怨憎想，謂彼長夜是我等怨。又從貪愛而生瞋恚，名貪所生瞋恚業道。復次，若九惱事增上力故，從怨對想起損害心，名瞋所生瞋恚業道。若住此法及外道法，所有沙門、若婆羅門憎惡他見，於他見所及懷彼見沙門、婆羅門所起損害心，名癡所生瞋恚業道。復次，若作是心：諸有此見撥無施與，乃至廣說彼於王等獲大供養及衣服等。即以此義增上力故，起如是見，名貪所生邪見業道。若作是心：有施、有愛，乃至廣說如是見者違害於我，我今不應與怨同見。彼由憎恚，起如是見：無施、無愛，乃至廣說。名瞋所生邪見業道。
items.en: Thinking that lying to ascetics or brahmins who oppose the heavens, Brahmā, or brahmins accords with the true Dharma — such lying arises from delusion. Thinking a lie is genuinely lawful and disciplined, and, through concealment, that even splitting the community is no wrongdoing — this too arises from delusion. As with false speech, so too with divisive speech and harsh speech, accordingly. Moreover, idle chatter for amusement, to display cleverness, or for profit, praise, and comfort, is generated by greed. Idle chatter according to the nine grounds of ill will is generated by hatred. Idle chatter believed to serve truth, stability, liberation, or the Dharma is generated by delusion. Moreover, noting another non-enemy's wealth and craving it become one's own, greed generating further greed, is covetousness generated by greed. Not regarding another's wealth as genuinely desirable, but through the nine grounds of ill will wishing it all belonged to oneself, hatred generating craving, is covetousness generated by hatred. Thinking that fixing the mind upon rebirth in the worlds of Rudra, Viṣṇu, Indra, or Brahmā secures great blessing is covetousness generated by delusion.

blocks.text: The same analysis for misconduct, speech, and the mental courses.

Master Cháng Bǎi: no desire was present beforehand; provoked, one acts from anger, for revenge. Lying for respected elders, for cow-observances, or for sacrificial items, holding the lie lawful, is delusion-born. Fearing others will borrow, saying one has no money, is greed-born.

Master Cháng Bǎi: lying to those one thinks deserve no respect, as if lawful, is delusion. Pointless speech for money or praise is greed-born; speaking in order to seek release, under wrong view, is delusion-born. Wanting another's wealth only so that they get no good is craving born of hatred; thinking fixed attention on heavens brings blessing is delusion.
"Holding the lie lawful." The most stubborn wrongs are those we think are right.

quiz.q: The English has "carried out under compulsion." What is the problem?
options: 勉勵 is forcing oneself, not outer coercion, and may be confused with §7's compelled act
no problem: without desire one must be forced
the problem is "revenge"
the problem is "purely"
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: no desire was manifest beforehand; provoked, one does it from anger, for revenge. It is one's own resolve. "Under compulsion" suggests the §7 case that weakens karma, whereas here it stays a hatred-born offence. The next clause on instigation also mirrors theft.

quiz.q: The English has "or for cattle" for 或復為牛. What sense is lost?
options: nothing: cattle were wealth in India, unrelated to observance, the lecture agreeing
it refers to outsiders' cow-observance, not to cattle as property
it should be "for milk"
it should be "for the farmer"
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: for respected elders, for cow-observance, or for sacrificial items, one holds a lie lawful. As it stands in the delusion list, the point is religious, not financial. "For cattle" would read as property and belong under greed. The Sub-commentary agrees.

quiz.q: How do greed-born and hatred-born lies differ?
options: greed-born to parents, hatred-born to friends, by listener, regardless of motive
greed-born severed by vision; hatred-born by cultivation
for gain, fear for wealth, praise, comfort; on the nine grounds of ill will
both born of delusion
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi's example: fearing others will damage one's wealth, one says one has no money, afraid they will borrow. The motive decides the poison. The English follows the Chinese closely here.

quiz.q: The English has "deserve lies rather than truth." What is lost?
options: nothing: it means they deserve it, belonging under hatred, the lecture correcting the treatise
沙門 is lost
妄語 is lost
the point that the lie accords with Dharma, delusion's key; only "they deserve it" remains
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: such persons deserve no respect, and to lie to them accords with Dharma. Delusion lies in thinking the lie is lawful. The English keeps only the idea of desert; compare its "lawful and disciplined" in the next sentence, which is fine.

quiz.q: What are idle chatter born of greed, hatred, and delusion?
options: amusement, display, gain; the nine grounds; for truth, stability, release, or Dharma
insults, praise, and muttering, classified by content regardless of motive
all born of greed
all born of delusion
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: speaking pointlessly for money, praise, or comfort is greed-born; speaking in order to seek release or Dharma is wrong-view delusion-born. Even a religious aim can be idle chatter if the words are empty. The English is accurate.

quiz.q: What are hatred-born and delusion-born covetousness?
options: anger wishing the wealth be one's own; mind fixed on heavens, craving existence
envy of wealth and unawareness of one's own wealth, both worldly, unrelated to heavens
both crave food
both crave fame
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: out of anger one wants the other's wealth so that the other gets no good, craving born of hatred; thinking fixed attention on heavens brings blessing is the craving for further existence, born of delusion. The English "hatred generating craving" is accurate.
